parts.t: Coal Harbour is Vancouver's crown jewel of waterfront living — a refined neighbourhood of luxury high-rises, a world-class marina, and stunning views of the North Shore mountains. Steps from the Seawall, Stanley Park, and downtown's financial district, it represents the pinnacle of urban Vancouver living.
